properties.decision: A new edge type SCHEDULED_FOR runs from Requirement or Capability to a DesignEpoch or a Release, carrying a `modality` property with values `expected` (a plan) and `required` (an obligation whose miss at arrival is a computed violation — the scheduling face of a KPP). One edge type serves both of the paired views: epochs for the time axis, releases for the capability-increment axis. Chosen by Anthony 2026-07-30 over two rejected alternatives.
properties.name: The satisfaction schedule is an edge carrying modality, not an overloaded pin and not a node
properties.rationale: REJECTED: overloading AT_EPOCH. It is declared `from: "*"` to DesignEpoch and its extraction hint says a Snapshot or ChangeEvent is pinned to the epoch it BELONGS TO. Adding schedule semantics would give one edge type two unrelated meanings — belongs-to and due-at — over a wildcard source, so nothing could tell them apart. That is the exact shape of the wrong-direction edge found on 2026-07-30: an edge that reads correctly and is still undetectably wrong, because no second contradicting fact exists to make its error computable. REJECTED: a Commitment/Schedule node. Heavier, and justified only if a scheduled claim must carry rationale, owner or confidence as first-class fields. It does not today, and confidence in particular should be MEASURED from arrival history rather than authored (dec:arrival-delta). CHOSEN, and why the edge: modality is a property of the RELATIONSHIP between an item and a moment, not of either endpoint — the same capability can be `expected` at one epoch and `required` by another, so putting it on either node would collapse that. It also leaves 3470 existing edges untouched. THE ABSENT THIRD MODALITY IS THE LOAD-BEARING PART: Anthony's three verbs are ARE satisfied, EXPECTED to be satisfied, and REQUIRED to be satisfied by — but `achieved` is deliberately NOT a value here. dec:arrival-delta and req:completion-computed already settle that delivery is computed from the golden thread and never asserted; storing it as a schedule modality would create a second source of truth that can disagree with the first, and a plan that records its own success is the plan lying about itself.
